about: Channels the niche radar scans (bun run ideas --watchlist). Pick channels whose viewers are the viewers you want: mostly US/UK/Canada/Australia English speakers, explaining how money systems work. A channel stays only if its uploads are in the channel's promise; remove it when its outliers keep landing outside it. 'why' is for you; the scan ignores it. Handles are checked against YouTube on the first scan; one that does not resolve is reported and skipped.
